text:
deploy-bot: Wave 18 scheduled by @emma for 2026-06-05T22:00Z. Services: api, runtime, console, router. Change window: 2h. Strategy: phased canary -> gradual traffic shift. Rollback on: >5% error rate or >200ms p95 increase for 5m.

emma: pinning runtime to v4.1.2-kernel-ff to avoid the new kernel branch impact. Console will go to console@2026-06-05-rc3. Router will get hedging tweak.

shawn: noted. runtime pin sounds good. what's the canary config? prefer 1% then 5%

emma: plan: 1% for 10m, if OK -> 5% for 10m, then 25% for 15m, then full. Canary evals: latency, error, qps, mem.

raj: rollback criteria: any 5m window with error >5% or p95 increase > 30% relative to baseline -> immediate rollback. Also if KV cache miss rate >2x baseline.

li: console contract change: PR #482 added /routes v2 response field `resource_hint`. Console needs migration flag off by default. Release note: 'Console: opt-in routing hint field (clients must opt in)'.

maria: pls include release-notes snippet. I'll publish staging notes before cutover.

shawn: router: set hedging threshold to 12% and max parallel retries 2 for canary. That mitigates backpressure oscillation.

sre-oncall: traffic cushion set to 10% spare capacity in eu-west-1. Observability hooks: add smoke test that hits /health + generate 5k token gen request to test runtime batching.

emma: adding these to release notes and runbook. snippets:
```
runtime: v4.1.2-kernel-ff
router: hedging=12%, retries=2
console: release=rc3, migration_flag=false
canary: 1% 10m -> 5% 10m -> 25% 15m
rollback: error>5% || p95>+30% || kv_miss_rate>2x
```

deploy-bot: Please confirm readiness by reacting :thumbsup:. Deadline to lock pins 2026-06-05T20:30Z.

shawn: :thumbsup: locking runtime pin.

li: :thumbsup: console migration flag set to false.

maria: I'll push release notes draft in #release-notes in 15m.

raj: SRE will be on pager during rollout. We'll start canary at T+0.

emma: thanks team. If canary fails we'll abort and roll back all services to previous pins. I'll post final runbook in this thread before T-30.
